name: Wireless Device Manager
description:
See what one wireless device is doing without opening Windows Settings or a vendor app.

Wireless Device Manager Lite gives one selected wireless peripheral a reusable Stream Deck key for device status, battery information, charging state, and connect/disconnect control when a reliable control path actually exists. It combines Windows Bluetooth telemetry with direct USB/HID telemetry for supported 2.4 GHz receiver devices. Initial direct HID support includes the LAMZU Maya X in both receiver and wired charging modes.

Device-reported battery percentage and charging state are shown only when Windows or a supported device protocol exposes them. Devices without telemetry simply show that the capability is unavailable. Connect/disconnect is also capability-gated rather than pretending every wireless keyboard, mouse, controller, headphones, headset, or receiver can be forced online.

One configurable action can show STATUS, BATTERY, or CONTROL for your selected device. When exactly one usable device is visible, PackRat selects it automatically. A ready-made Stream Deck profile includes MY DEVICE, BATTERY, and CONNECT keys for Standard, Mini, XL, Stream Deck+, and Stream Deck Neo. The Plus profile uses keys only; there is no fake dial action.

Windows 10 or newer. No separate companion app, account, cloud service, or customer-installed helper is required.

Upgrade to Wireless Device Manager Pro for multiple devices, favorites, device groups, low-battery alerts, Cycle Device, dashboards, and complete multi-device profiles.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- One selected wireless device with live Bluetooth or supported USB/HID telemetry
- LAMZU Maya X battery and charging support over 2.4 GHz receiver or wired USB
- Capability-gated audio connect/disconnect on supported Bluetooth devices
- Standard, Mini, XL, Stream Deck+, and Neo key profiles
